title: Mouse in Cosmic Bubble
description: A small brown mouse sits on a leafy branch inside a large transparent sphere filled with glowing blue lightning, golden stars, and a bright central burst of light. The sphere floats in deep space surrounded by vibrant purple, pink, and blue spiral galaxies and sparkling energy bursts.
prompt: A small brown mouse perched on a leafy green branch inside a large transparent glass sphere floating in deep space. Inside the sphere are glowing blue electric lightning bolts forming a heart shape, golden sparkling stars, and a bright central light burst. The sphere is surrounded by vibrant swirling purple, pink, and blue spiral galaxies with glowing centers and bright orange energy sparks against a black cosmic background.
